reading.title: Helpers in Our Community
reading.purpose: Learn about people who help in our community.
paras: Our community is full of helpers. A nurse helps sick kids. A mail carrier brings letters to each neighbor.
My family goes to the library. A kind worker helps us pick books. We say thank you to every helper. We are glad.

qs.q: A helper makes things easier for others. Who is a helper?
qs.why: A nurse helps sick kids, so a nurse is a helper.

qs.q: Who brings letters to each neighbor?
qs.why: The reading says a mail carrier brings letters to each neighbor.
The reading says the family goes to the library.

reading.retellFrame: A helper in our community is a ___.
